newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Frankie Dominion shrs down on profit fall.
newsitem.headline: Frankie Dominion shrs down on profit fall.

text.p: Shares of household products maker Frankie Dominion International Ltd fell to its intraday low after it reported a sharp drop in interim earnings.

"Investors were seen switching out from the stock after it reported a sharp fall in earnings, and its profitabilty was also seen to be very low in view of its turnover," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.

Its shares fell HK$0.055 or 12.36 percent to an intraday low of HK$0.39 per share. The company earlier announced a 63.6 percent fall in interim earnings to HK$6.16 million on turnover of HK$457.74 million. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
